payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the inference models used to estimate socioeconomic status (SES) from online behavioral data, particularly from Twitter users.

claims.text: The inference models for estimating socioeconomic status rely on three datasets: socioeconomic census data, crawled profession information, and expert annotated Google Street View images.
The best performance in predicting SES was achieved using LinkedIn data, which outperformed census-based inference and expert annotated data.
Gaussian Processes have been applied to predict user income, occupation, and socioeconomic class based on demographic and psycho-linguistic features.
